power_law.weighting: unweighted OLS in log10(price) vs log10(days-since-genesis) space
power_law.cycle_top_note: ZigZag swing detection over the same price_daily.json this fit already uses: a running high is confirmed a cycle top once price later falls cycle_top_drawdown_confirm_pct from it; a running low is confirmed a bottom once price later rises cycle_top_recovery_confirm_pct from it. 70%/50% were chosen because they reproduce the canonical list of major Bitcoin cycle tops with zero hand-picking (verified against the full committed history). This is one of three mechanical rules compute_cycle_tops() unions (the other two: each halving era's own peak sigma-vs-trend excursion, and the current open era's highest close to date) -- see MODEL_METHODOLOGY.md before changing any of it. Every point is reported as its deviation (sigma_vs_trend) from THIS SAME fit's a/b/sigma -- no second curve is fit through the tops themselves.
